title: Global Regulatory & Statutory Open Metadata Index (2024–2026) — 37,762 Official Dossiers Across 37 Jurisdictions
description:
Automated, machine-readable bibliographic metadata catalog (CSV, JSONL, Frictionless Data Package, and complete per-jurisdiction Markdown directories) indexing 37,762 official primary and secondary laws, final and proposed rules, statutory instruments, central bank circulars, supreme audit reports, and multilateral resolutions across 816 government departments, ministries, regulatory agencies, and multilateral organs in 37 active jurisdictions: United States (15,157 dossiers | Catalog), United Kingdom (2,352 dossiers | Catalog), Canada (5,358 dossiers | Catalog), European Union (3,497 dossiers | Catalog), United Nations (6,924 dossiers | Catalog), Ireland (172 dossiers | Catalog), Australia (1,262 dossiers | Catalog), International (927 dossiers | Catalog), Austria (156 dossiers | Catalog), Switzerland (182 dossiers | Catalog), Finland (66 dossiers | Catalog), France (362 dossiers | Catalog), South Korea (66 dossiers | Catalog), Norway (71 dossiers | Catalog), Italy (66 dossiers | Catalog), Philippines (196 dossiers | Catalog), Poland (43 dossiers | Catalog), South Africa (46 dossiers | Catalog), India (15 dossiers | Catalog), Belgium (25 dossiers | Catalog), Brazil (84 dossiers | Catalog), Japan (88 dossiers | Catalog), Netherlands (31 dossiers | Catalog), Russia (34 dossiers | Catalog), Sweden (47 dossiers | Catalog), China (26 dossiers | Catalog), Czechia (36 dossiers | Catalog), Germany (149 dossiers | Catalog), Denmark (32 dossiers | Catalog), Estonia (16 dossiers | Catalog), Spain (37 dossiers | Catalog), Israel (139 dossiers | Catalog), Iceland (1 dossiers | Catalog), Lithuania (0 dossiers | Catalog), Portugal (16 dossiers | Catalog), Singapore (82 dossiers | Catalog), Ukraine (1 dossiers | Catalog).

Full plain-English executive briefings, structured HTML compliance matrices, semantic definition lists, two-stage Tables of Contents, authority RSS syndication feeds, and unabridged source PDF dossiers are accessible via each record's canonical URL on https://www.indexdata.org, the Complete Issuing Authority Directory, the AI/LLM manifests (llms.txt and llms-full.txt), and Wikidata entity Q142071440.
